gaussian_copula.construction: factor model with one global factor plus six domain factors plus independent indicator noise

model_protocol.evaluation: 10 repeats of stratified 5-fold cross-validation; same folds for all comparators
model_protocol.full_model_inputs: one-hot status of G1 scope, six G2 controls, and two G4 requirements, plus latency p95 and peak memory; G3 is inferred from the raw resource values
model_protocol.operating_threshold: fixed at 0.50 before evaluation; no validation- or held-out-informed threshold selection
model_protocol.oracle: restate the observed rule-derived label; a tautological specification-identity check, not predictive evidence
model_protocol.uncertainty_reporting: mean, sample SD, minimum and maximum across ten CV repeats; split variability, not confidence intervals or independent external validation

status: newly specified synthetic Phase I run; not a reproduction of the historical run

synthetic_rule_assumptions.G1_scope_scenario: Scope status is simulated from a fixed scenario distribution: PASS 90%, FAIL 5%, UNKNOWN 5%; this is an analyst-selected stress-test mix, not an empirical rate
synthetic_rule_assumptions.G2_control_status: Each of six measured control proxies I01-I06 is PASS when >= 0.05 and FAIL when < 0.05; evidence degradation may turn PASS into UNKNOWN
synthetic_rule_assumptions.G3_runtime_status: PASS only when measured p95 latency < 200 ms and maximum of 30 memory readings < 100 MB; any measured breach is FAIL
synthetic_rule_assumptions.G4_other_requirements: REQ-A uses I17 >= 0.15; REQ-B uses I18 >= 0.15; measured value below threshold is FAIL; evidence degradation may turn PASS into UNKNOWN
synthetic_rule_assumptions.conjunctive_gate_precedence: FAIL if any mandatory subcondition is FAIL; otherwise UNKNOWN if any subcondition is UNKNOWN; otherwise PASS
synthetic_rule_assumptions.eligibility: G1 PASS AND G2 PASS AND G3 PASS AND G4 PASS; FAIL or UNKNOWN on any gate is not eligible
synthetic_rule_assumptions.evidence_injection: For each PASS control or requirement item, missing/stale/unreviewed is injected with probability 0.05 each; FAIL states are unchanged
synthetic_rule_assumptions.measurement_noise: 30 per-environment latency and memory readings with mean-corrected lognormal multiplicative noise sigma=0.15
synthetic_rule_assumptions.unknown_status: UNKNOWN represents missing, stale, unreviewed, or unverifiable evidence; it is not used for a known numeric threshold failure
